name: prospecting
description: Find US local businesses, save lists, and fill owner contacts, status, and custom fields. Sign in to your VOYGR account on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Lead lists of US local businesses
interface.longDescription: Find US local businesses, save them as lists, and fill owner contacts, status, hours, websites, or custom attributes. The plugin connects to the Prospecting MCP server at api.voygr.tech. Sign in once in your browser; no API key is needed for the plugin. Counting and reading are free. The skill asks before paid actions, and the server quotes larger runs. US places only.
defaultPrompt: Find 20 jewelers in Austin and save them as a list.
Fill owner names and emails for my list of local businesses.
